7\. Kits can still weaken the gate their pr merges on 🐞 Bug ⛨ Security 
carries_ci only treats an entry as CI when its casefolded path begins with .github/ or equals
scripts/check. The gate that scripts/check runs (uv sync, ruff check ., pytest) is also
configured by pyproject.toml, uv.lock and tests/conftest.py. An architect-filed kit that
changes one of those files (for example pytest addopts, a conftest that deselects tests, or ruff
excludes) is still approved by the engine without a human hold, and its own pull request's check
then runs the weakened gate it merges on, which is the exact risk §45's hold is meant to close.
